title: Short-term load forecasting under EU-AI Act Requirements in Safety-Critical Environments: Results from a 41-day live challenge on the aggregated German transmission-grid load
abstract: arXiv:2608.05018v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Short-term load forecasting (STLF) plays a vital role in the electric power industry. It is relevant for critical infrastructure. STLF is no longer purely a performance and accuracy problem, because determinism, fail-safe handling, minimal-attack surface, and no dead code are software-engineering requirements rather than optional extras. This report describes results from a 41-day live challenge that evaluated an STLF pipeline for the aggregated German transmission-grid load. The STLF pipeline predicts the 24 hourly load values of a target day from European Network of Transmission System Operators for Electricity (ENTSO-E) data. It is based on the open-source Python library spotforecast2-safe, which tries to implement the EU-AI Act Requirements in Safety-Critical Environments by design. The STLF pipeline includes gap- and anomaly-aware data preprocessing, calendar and weather covariates, and a forecasting algorithm. Forecast quality

translated_title: 欧盟人工智能法案要求下安全关键环境中的短期负荷预测：德国输电网络总负荷41天实时挑战结果
translated_abstract: 短期负荷预测（STLF）在电力行业中扮演着至关重要的角色，它关系到关键基础设施。STLF不再仅仅是性能和准确性问题，因为确定性、故障安全处理、最小攻击面以及无死代码已成为软件工程要求，而非可选项。本报告描述了一项为期41天的实时挑战结果，该挑战评估了针对德国输电网络总负荷的STLF管道。该STLF管道从欧洲输电系统运营商网络（ENTSO-E）数据预测目标日的24小时负荷值。它基于开源Python库spotforecast2-safe，该库试图在设计上实现欧盟人工智能法案在安全关键环境中的要求。STLF管道包括间隙和异常感知的数据预处理、日历和天气协变量以及预测算法。预测质量
tldr: 本论文通过41天实时挑战验证了一个符合欧盟AI法案安全要求的STLF管道，强调在关键基础设施中预测的软件工程稳健性（如确定性、故障安全）与准确性同等重要。
en_tdlr: This paper validates an STLF pipeline in a 41-day live challenge that meets EU-AI Act safety requirements, emphasizing that software engineering robustness (e.g., determinism, fail-safe) is as critical as accuracy in critical infrastructure.
